task_summary: Engineered pixel-perfect Academic Excel Gantt Chart replication with pure-client SpreadsheetML (.xls) export, normalized canonical section formatting to BSIT-4A (T87) with instructor configuration in CreateAcademicNodeDialog and student selection in ProfilePage and CreateProjectPage, strictly eliminated legacy BSIT 4-A from the hierarchy navigator in favor of BSIT-4A, and realigned Gantt Chart and prototype assets from Capstone 2 to Capstone 3 on the Submissions page with dedicated modal viewer.
author: Master Systems Architect & Apex Cognitive Agent (BukSU CMS-V2 Orchestrator)

client.description: Implemented pure client SpreadsheetML XML generator (.xls) supporting multi-row metadata header, XML cell border styles, custom hex fill colors (#FACC15, #22C55E, #F97316, #3B82F6), 4-tier timeline matrix, and 4-column signature block.

Created pixel-perfect React replica of BukSU Academic Excel Gantt Chart with 5-row bordered metadata header, sticky 7-column data grid, 60-column 4-tier timeline matrix (Months, Weeks, Working Days, Days 1..5), color-coded task bars, and 4-column signatory block.
Integrated AcademicExcelGanttChart as flagship default view with toggle between Academic Excel and Modern Roadmap, owner filter, and direct Export to Excel (.xls) action.
Created centralized section utility providing formatCanonicalSectionName (eliminates BSIT 4-A, guarantees BSIT-4A) and formatSectionWithCode (formats as BSIT-4A (T87)).
Added Year & Cluster (4A) and Section Code (T87) inputs with live canonical preview (BSIT-4A (T87)), helper guidance, and normalized payload submission.
Sanitized section filter options and folder-style hierarchy navigator breadcrumbs to strictly display BSIT-4A (never BSIT 4-A).
Updated section select options to render formatSectionWithCode(s) so students can select their exact section code (e.g. BSIT-4A (T87)).
Updated resolvedSectionName to formatSectionWithCode(match) with fallback 'BSIT-4A (T87)'.
Updated team cards and section filter dropdown to display formatSectionWithCode.
Updated team section badge rendering to use formatSectionWithCode.
Updated section dropdown option labels to use formatSectionWithCode.
Realigned header and copy to Capstone 3 System Development Assets and added trigger button to open the Academic Excel Gantt Chart modal.

Separated submissions page into phased architecture: Phase 2 (Capstone 2: Chapters 1-3 & Proposal) vs Phase 3 (Capstone 3: System Development Assets & Chapters 4-5), with header Academic Gantt button and full interactive modal.

post_mortem.lesson: SpreadsheetML 2003 XML (.xls) provides complete formatting control (exact border weights, cell merges, and background colors) directly from client JavaScript without bulky third-party dependencies, allowing high-fidelity exports that open cleanly in Microsoft Excel.
post_mortem.learned: Legacy naming anomalies like 'BSIT 4-A' vs 'BSIT-4A' easily contaminate hierarchy navigators if raw database strings are rendered directly without canonical normalization. Centralizing formatCanonicalSectionName and formatSectionWithCode across all UI surfaces ensures consistent institutional presentation (e.g. BSIT-4A (T87)).
post_mortem.prevention: Always sanitize section names with regex stripping space before hyphen (/([A-Z]+)\s+(\d)-?([A-Z])/i -> '$1-$2$3'). In forms where instructors enter year and cluster (e.g. 4 and A), derive canonical section string immediately and display live preview so users see the exact formatted string before submission.
post_mortem.runbook: When realigning lifecycle artifacts (e.g. moving Gantt Chart and Demo Video from Capstone 2 to Capstone 3), update both presentation copy, page architecture (ProjectSubmissionsPage.jsx phased cards), and component trigger links simultaneously.
